name: Adherent to a Mandalorian Tradition
description: You follow a minor, specific Mandalorian custom, even if you are not Mandalorian. This could be tapping your chest before combat, refusing to sit with your back to a door, or reciting a particular proverb in stressful situations.

name: Always wears a specific item of clothing
description: You have a signature piece of apparel—a battered helmet, a lucky charm on a necklace, a specific style of worn leather gloves—that you are never seen without.

name: Atheist/Skeptic
description: In a galaxy where the Force is a tangible reality, you are deeply skeptical of its power, dismissing it as superstition, Jedi mind tricks, or misunderstood technology.

name: Broad-minded
description: You are exceptionally open to new ideas, cultures, and alien customs, rarely passing judgment.

name: Careful
description: You are meticulous and cautious, often double-checking your gear, plans, and surroundings. This is not cowardice, but a deep-seated need for preparedness.

name: Chauvinistic
description: You believe your species, homeworld, or culture is inherently superior to all others.

name: Congenial
description: You are naturally friendly and eager to please.

name: Curious
description: You have a strong desire to know things, sometimes to your detriment. You might poke your nose into places it doesn't belong or ask too many questions.

name: Czerka Loyalist (Minor)
description: You believe that Czerka Corporation, despite its reputation, is a force for order and progress in the galaxy. You tend to defend their actions and trust their representatives.

name: Dark Side Tainted
description: You feel a subtle pull from the Dark Side. When confronted with a choice, you feel a fleeting temptation to take the faster, more aggressive path. This does not mean you are evil, but you must actively resist these impulses. GM Note: This may require occasional self-control rolls in moments of extreme anger or fear.

name: Dislikes a specific group
description: You have an irrational aversion to a particular group, such as droids, a specific alien species (e.g., 'I can't stand the chittering of Verpine'), or a corporate entity.

name: Distractible
description: Your attention wanders easily. A passing datapad screen or an interesting conversation can pull you away from the task at hand.

name: Dreamer
description: Your head is often in the clouds, contemplating philosophies, grand plans, or far-off places, sometimes at the expense of paying attention to the here-and-now.

name: Dull
description: You have very little imagination and a strictly literal, pragmatic view of the world.

name: Egotistical
description: You talk about yourself and your accomplishments frequently, often exaggerating your role in successful endeavors.

name: Follows a strict personal code
description: You have a set of self-imposed rules you will not break (e.g., 'Never deal with Hutts,' 'Always pay my debts,' 'Never leave a squadmate behind').

name: Force-Insensitive Commentary
description: You frequently make light of the Force, referring to Jedi abilities as "hokey religions" or "fancy laser sword tricks," not out of malice, but out of a genuine lack of understanding.

name: Haunted by the War
description: The horrors of the Mandalorian Wars have left a mark. You might occasionally fall silent, lost in a memory, or have a low tolerance for loud, sudden noises that remind you of blaster fire.

name: Humble
description: You consistently downplay your own achievements and importance.

name: Imaginative
description: You have a vivid imagination, which can be a source of brilliant ideas or baseless paranoia.

name: Incurious
description: You are content with what you know and rarely seek out new information or experiences.

name: Jedi Sympathizer
description: You hold the Jedi Order in high regard, perhaps idealizing the tales of their wisdom and prowess. You are more likely to trust and help individuals you believe to be Jedi.

name: Light Side Affinity
description: You have a natural inclination toward compassion and serenity. You feel a pang of guilt when you act selfishly and find it easier to show mercy than to seek revenge. GM Note: This quirk might offer a small, situational bonus (+1) to resist fear or intimidation when protecting others.

name: Likes a specific group
description: You have a notable fondness for a particular group, such as Wookiees, droids, or a specific alien culture.

name: Nosy
description: You are actively interested in other people's business and may eavesdrop or snoop.

name: Old Republic Patriot
description: You are a staunch believer in the ideals of the Republic, even as its bureaucracy and military struggles are laid bare by the war. You may salute Republic soldiers or speak fondly of Coruscant.

name: Oversensitive
description: You are easily insulted or emotionally wounded by perceived slights.

name: Prejudiced Against Droids
description: You view droids not just with dislike, but as inferior objects. You might call them "clankers" or "tin cans" and refuse to acknowledge them as anything more than tools.

name: Proud
description: You have a strong sense of self-worth and dignity and will react poorly to insults or challenges to your honor.

name: Responsive
description: You are a 'go-getter' who is always the first to volunteer or act on a new idea.

name: Shy
description: You are uncomfortable in social situations, especially with strangers, and tend to speak only when spoken to.

name: Squeamish
description: You are easily unnerved by the sight of blood, gore, or serious injury.

name: Staid
description: You are serious, sober, and not given to flights of fancy or strong emotional displays.

name: Struggles with a particular technology
description: You are inept with a common piece of tech. For example, you might be unable to operate astromech droids properly.

name: Talkative
description: You talk constantly, filling silences with chatter, stories, or observations, sometimes revealing more than you should.

name: Tech Scavenger
description: You have a habit of compulsively stripping downed droids, broken equipment, or abandoned consoles for spare parts, convinced they might be useful later. You often have pockets full of random wires, power cells, and processors.

name: Uncongenial
description: You are grumpy, reserved, and generally difficult to get along with.

name: Vow
description: You have a minor vow, such as never drinking alcohol or never refusing a request for aid from a child.

name: Wary of Force Users
description: Having seen or heard of the power wielded by Jedi and their dark counterparts, you are inherently suspicious of anyone who can use the Force. You keep your distance and watch them closely.
